overloadMerges.note: numsArray and namesArray are both documented and arrow-marked ('←') as arrays filled by the command with the choice lists' numbers/names, not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills numsArray and namesArray, as two synchronized output arrays, with the reference numbers and names of every choice list defined by the Design-mode list editor.
